method:
Measure every mattress, including paired, stowed/deployed trundle and adult bunks.

Read-only native meshes, direct per-part dimensions and physical support contacts.
The nominal 165 mm value is height above support; geometry has a 3 mm seated join.
This is static-prop geometry evidence, not a physical product safety certification.
